recipe.radius_gauge: arithmetic mean of three shared knot radii equals one; two softmax logits
recipe.frame_scale: height=98th percentile above local plane; independent fitted radial scale and centre
recipe.handle_rule: PCA long-axis sign from third moment about median; centre at long-axis p2 plus short radius; exclude +/-45 degree sector about positive long axis before fitting or scoring
recipe.unhandled_rule: de-ellipse PCA long coordinate by short/long 2-98 percentile span before fitting
recipe.frame_admission: v4 extents frames_used; finite positive valid depth; successful local ring refit; mask and extents match recorded measurement; >=300 retained points
recipe.residual: signed in-plane radial distance minus fitted scale times interpolated profile, divided by fixed frame reference radius (half short footprint span); equal-frame mean absolute value for evaluation
recipe.fit_sampling: equal per-frame count=min(1500, smallest frame), uniformly spaced raster-ordered point indices, deterministic
recipe.centre_bounds: plus/minus one reference radius from provisional body centre in each in-plane coordinate
recipe.split: frames ordered by split, episode and frame; alternating even/odd positions; each profile predicts opposite subset
recipe.heldout_nuisance: even raster-ordered retained pixels calibrate centre and radial scale with fixed shared profile; odd pixels scored; constant calibrated identically
recipe.coverage_definition: fraction of all scored heldout retained body-sector points with absolute radial residual <=0.10 fixed reference radius; no residual-tail filtering
recipe.height_support_definition: each disjoint subset needs 2-98 percentile height span >=0.60, >=6/10 occupied bins, and all three knot windows supported; occupied means >=max(20,ceil(1% subset points))
recipe.coverage_gate: equal-frame heldout mean profile coverage >= constant coverage
recipe.selection_data: public 42 video overlay and recorded measures, public 39 negative control only; no scan or CD-O data
recipe.choice_policy: single predeclared recipe; no search or post-result repair; failure drops R10
